title: ambush:finding:v1
description:
One DetectionFinding as a lane-channel evidence card. Produced from RuntimeEvent::Finding (crates/swarm-runtime/src/runtime_events.rs:224-228), which the daemon publishes on its broadcast channel and the bridge receives in-process through IngestState::subscribe_runtime_events (crates/swarm-ingest-runtime/src/ingest/mod.rs:1875-1881).

host_id comes from the RuntimeEvent WRAPPER, not from the envelope: SwarmFindingEnvelope (crates/swarm-response/src/siem.rs:17-27) has eight fields and none of them is a host. Verification tier 0 — DetectionFinding (crates/swarm-whisker/src/detector.rs:50-59, seven fields) carries no signature and neither does its envelope.

issuer.description: WHO PRODUCED THE FACT. See the envelope's `issuer` for who published it.

emitted_at_ms.description: The RuntimeEvent's own emitted_at_ms, carried through unchanged. THE SORT KEY for every Perch surface. The Nostr event's `created_at` is a transport timestamp stamped at publish, because MAX_TIMESTAMP_DRIFT_SECS is 900 and REJECTS (crates/buzz-relay/src/handlers/ingest.rs:2224-2231) and `created_at` is inside the Nostr signature, so a spooled card carrying its true emit time becomes permanently unpublishable fifteen minutes after it was produced.

event_id.description: The TELEMETRY event id, not the Nostr event id. Half of the feedback-suppression key: Dismiss builds FeedbackSuppressionKey{threat_class, event_id} (crates/swarm-pheromone/src/substrate.rs:345-348) and concentration_for then drops every matching deposit at or before the marker (:1286), reaching detectors the operator never reviewed.

schema.description: Hardcoded at siem.rs:33 in the From<&DetectionFinding> impl.

evidence.description: serde_json::Value, unconstrained, DERIVED FROM TELEMETRY AN ADVERSARY CAN SHAPE. Every string reached from here must be wrapped in <AdversaryString> (INV-14). Truncated by the bridge when the serialized card would exceed PERCH_CARD_MAX_BYTES; see 13-WIRE-SCHEMAS.md section 4.4.

evidence_truncated.description: Present only when the bridge replaced `evidence`. The card then renders an explicit absence with the byte count and the hash, never a silently smaller evidence blob.

finding.x-carried-note: This object is a domain type carried VERBATIM. The Rust wire crate names the type rather than redeclaring its fields, so a field added upstream reaches the wire with no edit and a field removed upstream is a compile error. tools/check-perch-wire-parity.sh skips its property names on the Rust side for exactly that reason, and the golden vectors plus this schema are what hold the shape.
